snippets.title: GraphQL Schema Definition
snippets.code:
type Query {
  getLoan(loanId: ID!): Loan
  searchLoans(criteria: LoanSearchInput!): LoanConnection!
  getLoanApplicationStatus(applicationId: ID!): ApplicationStatus!
}

type Mutation {
  createLoanApplication(input: LoanApplicationInput!): LoanApplication!
  submitForUnderwriting(loanId: ID!): UnderwritingResult!
  approveLoan(loanId: ID!, conditions: [String]): LoanApproval!
  rejectLoan(loanId: ID!, reason: String!): LoanRejection!
}

type Loan {
  id: ID!
  applicant: Applicant!
  loanType: LoanType!
  amount: Float!
  term: Int!
  interestRate: Float
  status: LoanStatus!
  documents: [Document!]!
  underwritingDecision: UnderwritingDecision
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
}

type UnderwritingDecision {
  id: ID!
  decision: Decision!
  confidence: Float!
  factors: [DecisionFactor!]!
  aiModelVersion: String!
  reviewedBy: String
  reviewedAt: DateTime
}

enum Decision {
  APPROVED
  CONDITIONAL_APPROVAL
  REFERRED
  DECLINED
}

snippets.title: Spring Boot Service Layer
Spring Cloud Config
Kubernetes Deployment
snippets.code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: loan-service
  namespace: aussie-prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: loan-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: loan-service
        version: v1
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: loan-service
        image: acr.azurecr.io/aussie/loan-service:1.2.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        env:
        - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
          value: "production"
        - name: SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: database-secret
              key: connection-string
        - name: AI_SERVICE_URL
          value: "http://ai-underwriting-service:8081"
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "512Mi"
            cpu: "500m"
          limits:
            memory: "1Gi"
            cpu: "1000m"
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /actuator/health/liveness
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 10
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /actuator/health/readiness
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: loan-service
  namespace: aussie-prod
spec:
  selector:
    app: loan-service
  ports:
  - protocol: TCP
    port: 8080
    targetPort: 8080
  type: ClusterIP

infrastructure.name: Azure SQL Database
infrastructure.code:
-- Loan table with partitioning for performance
CREATE TABLE loans (
    loan_id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    applicant_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    loan_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    amount DECIMAL(18, 2) NOT NULL,
    term INT NOT NULL,
    interest_rate DECIMAL(5, 2),
    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    updated_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    underwriting_decision_id VARCHAR(50),
    CONSTRAINT FK_loans_applicants FOREIGN KEY (applicant_id) 
        REFERENCES applicants(applicant_id),
    INDEX IX_loans_status (status, created_at),
    INDEX IX_loans_applicant (applicant_id)
) ON [PRIMARY];

-- Underwriting decisions table
CREATE TABLE underwriting_decisions (
    decision_id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    loan_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    decision VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    confidence DECIMAL(5, 4) NOT NULL,
    ai_model_version VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    factors NVARCHAR(MAX),
    reviewed_by VARCHAR(100),
    reviewed_at DATETIME2,
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT FK_decisions_loans FOREIGN KEY (loan_id) 
        REFERENCES loans(loan_id)
) ON [PRIMARY];

-- Stored procedure for loan submission
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_SubmitLoanForUnderwriting
    @LoanId VARCHAR(50),
    @UserId VARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    
    UPDATE loans
    SET status = 'PENDING_UNDERWRITING',
        updated_at = GETUTCDATE()
    WHERE loan_id = @LoanId
    AND status = 'DRAFT';
    
    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW 50001, 'Loan not in valid state for underwriting', 1;
    END
    
    INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, user_id, timestamp)
    VALUES ('LOAN', @LoanId, 'SUBMITTED_FOR_UNDERWRITING', @UserId, GETUTCDATE());
    
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END;

devops.name: Azure DevOps Pipeline
devops.code:
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - develop
  paths:
    include:
    - services/loan-service/**

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

variables:
  - group: aussie-prod-vars
  - name: imageName
    value: 'loan-service'
  - name: dockerRegistryServiceConnection
    value: 'aussie-acr'

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - job: BuildAndTest
    steps:
    - task: Maven@3
      inputs:
        mavenPomFile: 'services/loan-service/pom.xml'
        goals: 'clean package'
        options: '-DskipTests=false'
        javaHomeOption: 'JDKVersion'
        jdkVersionOption: '11'

    - task: PublishTestResults@2
      inputs:
        testResultsFormat: 'JUnit'
        testResultsFiles: '**/TEST-*.xml'

    - task: Docker@2
      inputs:
        command: 'buildAndPush'
        repository: '$(imageName)'
        dockerfile: 'services/loan-service/Dockerfile'
        containerRegistry: '$(dockerRegistryServiceConnection)'
        tags: |
          $(Build.BuildId)
          latest

- stage: Deploy
  dependsOn: Build
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployToAKS
    environment: 'aussie-production'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - task: Kubernetes@1
            inputs:
              connectionType: 'Kubernetes Service Connection'
              kubernetesServiceEndpoint: 'aussie-aks-prod'
              command: 'apply'
              useConfigurationFile: true
              configuration: 'k8s/loan-service-deployment.yaml'

          - task: Kubernetes@1
            inputs:
              command: 'set'
              arguments: 'image deployment/loan-service loan-service=$(containerRegistry)/$(imageName):$(Build.BuildId)'
